newsitem.title: USA: American Brands says spinoff is tax-free.
newsitem.headline: American Brands says spinoff is tax-free.

text.p: American Brands Inc said Wednesday the U.S. Internal Revenue Service has ruled that its plan to spin off its U.K.-based Gallaher tobacco business is as a tax-free transaction to U.S. stockholders.
The company said the ruling was a key condition necessary for the successful completion of the spinoff.
The company said it received shareholder approval for the spinoff and the change of its name to Fortune Brands Inc at its April 30 annual meeting.
The company said it is seeking listing of Gallaher's ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange.
The company said Gallaher's ADRs have been approved for listing on the New York Stock Exchange, and Fortune Brands shares will also be listed on the New York Stock Exchange.
The company said its board has set a May 30 record and payment date for the spin-off and name change.
On June 2, Fortune Brands will begin trading under the symbol "FO," and Gallaher ADRs, under the symbol "GLH."
